components.name: workbox-core (same project and authors as workbox-window)
components.evidence: NOT prebuilt by the plan's marker rule (no __webpack_require__, define.amd or wasmBinary): a rollup build that inlines another package with no runtime left. Found through its sibling source map. The sibling map lists ../../workbox-core/_version.js, _private/Deferred.js and _private/dontWaitFor.js; each sourcesContent is byte-identical to that file in the workbox-core 7.4.1 tarball (gitHead 62b9d8ba, the same as workbox-window 7.4.1's). Same project and copyright holder (Google LLC), so arguably nothing from "other authors"; recorded so the rule gap is visible.
